column2: Renewal-process pain is the most frequently voiced problem: 129 of 392 trusted records (33%).

Integration is the most acute pain at any meaningful scale: 64 of 92 integration records (70%) are high-intensity. Agency overflow rates higher (4 of 4) but on a base of four, so it is disclosed rather than ranked.
Integration alone accounts for 44% of all acute pain: 64 of the 147 high-intensity records, more than renewal (42) and data quality (16) combined.
Renewal and integration together are 56% of the corpus: 221 of 392 records.
HubSpot renewal integration pain is an accounting-sync problem: 66 of 92 integration records (72%) name NetSuite, Xero or QuickBooks.
The dedicated CRM-to-accounting set is the most consistently severe slice: 38 of 43 records (88%) are high-intensity.
One third of renewal complaints are already at crisis level: 42 of 129 (33%), with HubSpot blocking auto-created renewal deals to prevent an infinite loop as the recurring trigger.
Commissions is common but rarely acute: 48 of 392 records (12%), only 1 rated high-intensity.

column2: Frequencies describe collected records, which over-represent forums where people go to complain.
342 of 392 trusted records (87%) have no reliable industry tag, so the report makes no vertical-specific prevalence claims.
221 of 392 records have no role tag. Where role is known (171), operations admins and RevOps leaders are 142 of 171 (83%).
